mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship is consistent across historical data and does not require specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 20-day return when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% is negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rising consumer credit (RSAFS) signals strong labor market conditions and consumer spending, which together drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (UNRATE * RSAFS) has a negative Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns are not observed when UNRATE is falling and RSAFS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising FEDFUNDS), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in tightening cycles is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 60-day return is negative when INDPRO is above 100.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1300 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above 1300.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) reflects strong economic momentum, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for GDPC1 and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the average 60-day return is negative when GDPC1 is above 23700.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 thousand signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above 150000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
